scope: Only right patient and upper rescuer palm indices/normals, right patient wrist normals, and right patient primary/thumb crease positions/normals/path control points may differ. All other scene bytes, transforms, parameters, materials, metadata, counts and viewer configuration are preserved.
limitation: CPU raw-module scenes with bundled THREE r128. Skin fit covers every crease vertex plus each ribbon edge midpoint and triangle centroid and 129 center-path samples; it is not a proof over every continuous point. Browser, full application loader and full build are separate checks.
